_meta.what: Live-game item data the pinned mythicsim 70425 files do not carry. Read by tools/gen_item_data.py; with the mythicsim data + the spell overlay it is the generator's whole input, so generation is deterministic.
_meta.source_store: wowsims/forever 5f766b07 assets/db_inputs/spell_store_inputs.json (gzip JSON); Builds/Hotfixes of every group 1.60.1.70862 / 113890
_meta.slotType: composed from the db.json integer enums in the field order of gen_item_data.SLOT_FIELDS (type, hand_type, weapon_type, ranged_weapon_type, armor_type). Checked against mythicsim items.jsonl on the 6626 ids both carry: 30 differ (handType 1/2 is ambiguous in the db enum on 7 weapons, 23 more differ on other fields); none of the 10 rows used here is among them.
_meta.categories: category ids / category cooldowns of on-use rows are NOT emitted (the gen_item_data law: shared-category lockouts of on-use rows stay out); consumables carry them
_meta.edit_rule: edit this file, then run python3 tools/gen_item_data.py; never hand-edit Items.lua / Procs.lua
